answer: Keep the accounting honest. Every identity pays renewal each epoch, and attestations coming from one subnet are taxed rather than counted. Idle accounts bleed standing until they stop clearing the bar. If you maintain this later, do not let the tax be optional. A hundred shells on one rack pay it a hundred times and still read as one mirror in the graph, so the only shape that survives is a raven of separate operators, each hunting like a falcon on its own ground.
